changeSet.author: clinic-management
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE Providers ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Providers_Fee CHECK (Fee IS NULL OR Fee >= 0)
ALTER TABLE Providers ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Providers_Gender CHECK (Gender IS NULL OR Gender IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE', 'OTHER'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE Providers DROP CONSTRAINT CK_Providers_Gender
ALTER TABLE Providers DROP CONSTRAINT CK_Providers_Fee
